items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I remember him very well. Big Eye Louis.

ctx.x: He was one of the main stems in the group. Eddie Pearson and let's see, there was another guy who played a wonderful clarinet. His name was Elliot. What was Elliot's last name? Well I don't think he's in New Orleans now. I think he left New Orleans a good while ago.

Who were some of the other clarinetists you heard when you were a small boy? You mentioned Piku. Can you think of any others? Do you remember Big Eye Louis for instance? Louis DeLille was his real name.
Louis DeLille? Yes. I remember him very well. Big Eye Louis.
